title: Fix search
body:
## Description

Hello, I noticed that the search on [docs.cashu.space](https://docs.cashu.space) is broken. The DocSearch API throws an error with this message:

> Unreachable hosts - your application id may be incorrect. If the error persists, contact support@algolia.com.

To fix this, I applied for API access here: https://docsearch.algolia.com/apply/

I got approved and received the API credentials you can see in this PR. They are not sensitive since they must be present in the client and can only be used to query the content of [docs.cashu.space](https://docs.cashu.space).

Updating the env with these new API credentials was all that was needed, see video:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/77bdb79e-b9ad-4218-b077-fc08d5713e8d



## About DocSearch and Algolia

This explains how DocSearch works: https://docsearch.algolia.com/docs/how-does-it-work

As mentioned in the link, they create an Algolia application and a dedicated crawler:

> Once we receive [your application](https://docsearch.algolia.com/apply), we'll have a look at your website, create an Algolia application and a dedicated [crawler](https://www.algolia.com/products/search-and-discovery/crawler/) for it. Your crawler comes with [a configuration file](https://www.algolia.com/doc/tools/crawler/apis/configuration/) which defines which URLs we should crawl or ignore, as well as the specific CSS selectors to use for selecting headers, subheaders, etc.

Since I did no crawler configuration, there is probably still room to optimize search results by [configuring the crawler](https://www.algolia.com/doc/tools/crawler/apis/configuration/) but I would keep this for a future PR. At least the search works now.

**However, the admin UI for the crawler is located at https://crawler.algolia.com/ but since I applied, only I have currently access to it.**

**Ideally, the person that hosts the site should go to https://docsearch.algolia.com/apply/ and get new API credentials. But I can also invite people via email to share the admin UI if that's easier.**
